labels.symptom: Desktop installs give no documented, reliable way to run the bundled CLI from scripts or agents without relying on PATH.
labels.root_cause: Windows, AppImage and Flatpak packages don't put the CLI on PATH, and macOS ships it as a separate download.

labels.symptom: Korean text shows as boxes, and typing with a Korean input method gives separate letters instead of whole syllables.
labels.root_cause: No CJK fallback font is loaded, and IME composition events are not handled in text input.

labels.symptom: A text box in an imported presentation cannot be edited.
The save dialog defaults to the app's own extension and offers no choice of format such as the Office format.
labels.root_cause: The save file dialog has no format filters and defaults to the native extension.

labels.symptom: Zooming in goes toward a corner of the canvas instead of the mouse cursor, and zooming out sometimes doesn't work.
Document text in fonts such as Aptos looks different from how it looks in the original application.
labels.root_cause: Probably font substitution or differences in how text is shaped.

labels.symptom: Users with a Taiwan or Hong Kong system locale get Simplified Chinese instead of Traditional Chinese.
labels.root_cause: There is no zh-Hant interface catalog.

labels.symptom: There is no opt-in way to back up, version or share documents on storage the user owns (NAS, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 via rclone).
On Windows and Linux the window lacks the standard custom title bar and caption buttons, and there is no System Title Bar preference.
labels.root_cause: Window decoration handling not standardized to the shared custom title bar architecture.

labels.symptom: There is no way to replace an image in place while keeping its cropping and settings.
Audio and video set to play on next do not start when advancing the slideshow; they behave as click-to-play.
labels.root_cause: Media playback trigger settings from PPTX are ignored.

labels.symptom: Slide transitions shorter than one second in imported PPTX files are reset to one second.
labels.root_cause: Transition duration import clamps or rounds to a 1 second minimum.

labels.symptom: Cropped images with different cropping on consecutive slides fade or resize as a whole during Morph instead of animating the crop.
labels.root_cause: Morph transition does not interpolate image crop rectangles.

labels.symptom: During a Morph transition, elements present on only one slide move toward unrelated elements instead of fading in place.
labels.root_cause: Morph matching pairs unmatched elements with other elements instead of fading them.

labels.symptom: Presentations cannot be exported to modern HTML5 that keeps fonts and animations.
Live web content cannot be embedded inside a slide.
Pasted copies of an element are not linked, so editing one does not update the others.
There is no panel listing all imported media, so reusing it means hunting through slides.
Commonly reused objects cannot be marked as favorites for quick insertion.
Objects on a slide cannot be scrolled in place when their content is larger than the frame.
Media audio can only play on the default system output device; there is no per-object choice of device.
The keys and devices that advance the slideshow can't be remapped.
Slideshow recording can't save webcam and screen video as separate files for later editing.
There is no pane that lists all the interactive actions and links on a slide.
Slide actions can't send JSON, OSC or MIDI commands to external systems.
There is no local JSON API that can be switched on to control a running slideshow.
The Selection pane can only be opened from a submenu, not from a button that is always visible.
Objects can't be reordered or locked from the Selection pane by drag and drop.
On macOS, double-clicking a document in Finder launches the app but shows a 'cannot open files in this format' alert.
labels.root_cause: The bundle's Info.plist has no CFBundleDocumentTypes, and winit does not handle the kAEOpenDocuments Apple event.

labels.symptom: Arabic and right-to-left text and interface layout are not fully supported.
labels.root_cause: There is no bidirectional text layout or RTL interface mirroring.

labels.symptom: A single-series chart that should get an automatic title from its series name shows no title.
labels.root_cause: The renderer does not create the automatic title when autoTitleDeleted is 0 and there is no explicit title.

labels.symptom: All bars in a single-series chart are drawn in one colour instead of a different colour per point.
labels.root_cause: A missing c:varyColors element is read as false instead of true.

labels.symptom: Charts with an automatic value axis show a different scale and gridlines from Office.
labels.root_cause: The automatic axis scaling picks a different maximum and major unit than Office does.

labels.symptom: Some slide transitions render wrongly and are missing from the transitions menu.
Animation settings such as exit direction are ignored when opening existing presentations.
Equations in imported presentations show without fractions and integrals.
The interface language doesn't follow the system language and is hard to change.
On Windows the app exits right after the window appears with 'Parent device is lost' because the DXC shader compiler DLLs are missing.
labels.root_cause: Windows packages do not ship dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll, so wgpu's DX12 DXC pipeline compile fails and the device is lost.

labels.symptom: There is no way to insert a QR code.
There is no add-in API for third-party commands, ribbon tabs or task panes.
In dark mode some panel text is hard to read because of poor contrast.
The interface cannot be translated because there is no localization layer.
labels.root_cause: No i18n layer exists on main.

labels.symptom: The home button does nothing, there is no File menu, master slides can't add slide numbers or footers, the New Presentation layout is broken, and arrow keys don't advance slides while presenting.
The installer does not offer to add a desktop shortcut.
labels.root_cause: The installer has no optional desktop-shortcut step.

labels.symptom: On GNOME Wayland the window title bar is a plain fallback bar that ignores the desktop theme, dark mode and button layout.
labels.root_cause: eframe with default-features=false drops winit's wayland-csd-adwaita feature, so sctk-adwaita is not built.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Ukrainian.
There is no way to set text transparency; only the background opacity can be changed.
On Windows PCs with AMD graphics the app crashes at startup inside the AMD OpenGL driver.
labels.root_cause: The GPU setup uses an OpenGL path that crashes in AMD's atio6axx/atioglxx driver.

labels.symptom: The app has no System theme option, so it does not follow the macOS light/dark appearance.
labels.root_cause: Theme comes only from the saved manual setting; nothing reads the OS appearance.

labels.symptom: On macOS the app in the DMG fails strict codesign verification because its resources carry Finder info extended attributes.
labels.root_cause: Resources are packaged with com.apple.FinderInfo extended attributes that are not stripped before signing.

labels.symptom: Pasting an image copied from a browser or file manager does nothing.
labels.root_cause: Image data on the clipboard is probably not handled on paste.

labels.symptom: Icons inserted in PowerPoint don't appear when the presentation is opened.
labels.root_cause: The importer does not render the inserted icon graphics, which are likely SVG.

labels.symptom: A README link points to the old app URL from before the rename.
labels.root_cause: The README was not updated after the app was renamed.

labels.symptom: On Windows with Intel UHD Graphics the app crashes at startup with an access violation in igvk64.dll.
labels.root_cause: wgpu enumerates Vulkan adapters and the Intel Vulkan driver crashes; there is no fallback to DX12.

labels.symptom: Closing a document with unsaved edits discards it immediately without asking to save, discard or cancel.
labels.root_cause: The Close command does not check the dirty state before closing the document.

labels.symptom: Exporting all slides as PNG images in the browser exports only the selected slide.
Font weights other than Regular, Bold and Italic can't be used.
After saving to PPTX and reopening, comment reply threads and resolved status are gone.
labels.root_cause: PPTX export/import doesn't write or read comment replies and resolved state.

labels.symptom: On macOS the window's traffic-light controls are out of line with the title bar.
Comments and replies made in the browser build are saved without creation timestamps.
labels.root_cause: The browser/Wasm build doesn't fill in the time when it creates comments.

labels.symptom: Toolbar icons for the same functions look slightly different from those in other suite apps.
labels.root_cause: Each app ships its own icon set instead of a shared one.

labels.symptom: After exporting to PPTX and reopening, the autoplay, loop and rewind settings on audio and video are reset.
labels.root_cause: The PPTX export or import does not keep the media playback options.

labels.symptom: The files overlay is missing.
After exporting to PPTX and reopening, an animation's rewind setting is lost.
labels.root_cause: The PPTX export or import does not map the animation rewind attribute.

labels.symptom: After pressing Tab inside a text box, you can no longer type or delete text in that box.
labels.root_cause: The Tab key moves keyboard focus out of the text editor instead of inserting a tab or indenting.

labels.symptom: The command palette lists two entries with the same Export label, and the default one fails with a missing path error.
labels.root_cause: A palette command that needs a path is registered without prompting for one, next to a duplicate label.

labels.symptom: In the browser build, Arabic and Hebrew text renders and exports as missing-glyph boxes.
labels.root_cause: The default web build bundles no fonts covering Arabic and Hebrew scripts.

labels.symptom: Embedded video won't play in edit mode and plays very slowly in presentation mode while audio is fine.
Indented sub-items in a bulleted list cannot be typed into, and new lines drop out of the list.
The desktop app has no guided setup that finds the CLI and produces a working MCP configuration for an agent client.
labels.root_cause: No guided setup flow exists in the desktop UI.

labels.symptom: Docs refer to the renamed sibling app PrintCraft instead of PdfCraft.
labels.root_cause: Sibling app was renamed and docs were not updated.

labels.symptom: The README Downloads section doesn't say where to get the app first and lists macOS builds before Windows.
No Linux riscv64 release download is offered.
A host page that embeds the web build cannot open files in it or receive saved files; Save turns into a browser download instead.
In the slide show, clicking after a long pause shows the whole animation step at once.
labels.root_cause: The step clock was read before the click set the step start time.

labels.symptom: The interface is not available in Russian, Spanish, French, Portuguese or German.
There is no System theme option that follows the OS light/dark appearance.
labels.root_cause: The theme only offered manual Light and Dark choices.

labels.symptom: PR CI takes 30-50 minutes because slow FreeBSD and Windows ARM64 jobs run on almost every PR.
labels.root_cause: These workflows were triggered by lockfile changes and by pushes to main.

labels.symptom: During Morph, text boxes that appear or disappear fly across to unrelated text boxes instead of fading in place.
labels.root_cause: The geometry matching pass paired any shapes of the same kind, including text boxes with different text.

labels.symptom: A picture cropped differently on the next slide cross-fades during Morph instead of animating its crop.
labels.root_cause: Pictures that differed only in crop were treated as changed content and cross-faded.

labels.symptom: After pressing Tab while typing in a text box, further keystrokes are ignored.
labels.root_cause: egui treats Tab as focus navigation and moves focus to a toolbar widget, so the editor stops receiving keys.

labels.symptom: Table rows stored with zero height draw on top of each other, and table text is missing from PDF export.
labels.root_cause: Stored row heights were used as exact heights instead of minimums, and table cell text was not laid out for the PDF text layer.

labels.symptom: In a slide show, media set to play on Next only starts when you click it.
labels.root_cause: The slide show never runs the media effects from the click sequence that the PPTX reader already parses.

labels.symptom: On macOS the app inside the release DMG may not pass signature verification.
labels.root_cause: The packaging script did not verify the signed app inside the final DMG.

labels.symptom: Imported slide transitions shorter than a second play with longer default durations.
labels.root_cause: A missing spd attribute fell back to the effect's default duration instead of 'fast' (0.5 s).

labels.symptom: A single-series chart with autoTitleDeleted=0 and no explicit title shows no automatic title.
labels.root_cause: The chart title was set only from an explicit c:title.

labels.symptom: Single-series bar charts draw every column in the same colour instead of varying colours by point.
labels.root_cause: A missing c:varyColors was read as false, and the bar renderer ignored vary_colors.

labels.symptom: CI workflows are duplicated in every repo and raise Node 20 deprecation warnings.
Save As proposes the app's native extension instead of the standard Office format and the save dialog offers no file type choices.
labels.root_cause: The save dialog was always called with the native extension and no file type filters.

labels.symptom: Zooming with Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or pinch grows the canvas from the corner instead of keeping the point under the pointer fixed.
labels.root_cause: The zoom handler changed the scale without changing the scroll offset and ignored the pointer position.

labels.symptom: Chart value axes pick a different automatic scale and gridlines than Office.
labels.root_cause: The axis scaling targeted about five intervals with no headroom, always started at zero and ignored fixed min/max.

labels.symptom: On Windows with AMD graphics the app flashes in Task Manager and exits without a window or error.
labels.root_cause: The default wgpu instance turns on the GL backend, and initialising it crashes inside AMD's OpenGL driver atio6axx.dll.

labels.symptom: In dark mode some gallery labels are drawn in dark grey on the dark background and are hard to read.
labels.root_cause: The widget painter always used the light theme colours instead of the active theme.

labels.symptom: Slide show ink offers only a basic pen, with no colors, widths, eraser or laser pointer.
Many valid PowerPoint files are rejected as unreadable.
labels.root_cause: The file sniff looked for [Content_Types].xml only in the first 4 KB instead of in the zip central directory.

labels.symptom: Opening a crafted video file with hostile H.264/HEVC parameters crashes the app or decodes with nonsense dimensions.
labels.root_cause: Exp-Golomb values up to u32::MAX were added and summed without overflow checks in the H.264/HEVC parameter set parsers.

labels.symptom: On the start screen, tiles that wrap to a new row lose their left indent.
labels.root_cause: add_space inside horizontal_wrapped indents only the first row.

labels.symptom: Release builds queue for a long time behind macOS PR CI jobs.
labels.root_cause: PR CI used up the organisation's shared macOS runners.

labels.symptom: Building from source on Linux fails at alsa-sys and the README doesn't mention the ALSA headers.
labels.root_cause: The README didn't list the ALSA development package that cpal needs.

labels.symptom: A morph test did not really check that ids are unique.
labels.root_cause: dedup without sort only removes consecutive duplicates.

labels.symptom: Morph cross-fades shapes whose geometry changed instead of morphing the outline.
Linux desktops have no scalable SVG app icon, only raster sizes.
labels.root_cause: The hicolor/scalable SVG icon was never added to the assets.

labels.symptom: The About window has no Contributors or Models tabs listing who contributed.
The interface is only available in English, with no Ukrainian option or language choice.
Text inside flipped shapes is drawn mirrored or upside down.
labels.root_cause: The shape's flip transform was applied to its text as well as its geometry.

labels.symptom: Automatic date fields on slides are blank or show another slide's fixed date.
labels.root_cause: Date fields rendered the deck-wide fixed date text instead of computing the current date.

labels.symptom: Hyperlinked text looks like plain text, with no link colour or underline.
labels.root_cause: Run style resolution ignored the hyperlink and never applied the theme's hlink colour and underline.

labels.symptom: Animated GIFs show only their first frame and can't be played or paused.
labels.root_cause: The renderer decoded only the first frame of each GIF.

labels.symptom: Arabic and other right-to-left text is not shaped or ordered correctly.
labels.root_cause: There was no bidirectional (UAX #9) layout or complex-script shaping.

labels.symptom: The app ships a bundled emoji font it may not redistribute, and malformed or oversized files load unsafely.
labels.root_cause: A default emoji font bundle was included and file loading lacked size limits and validation.

labels.symptom: Releases are not versioned and drafted automatically.
Inserting a hyperlink with no text selected does nothing, and links can't be clicked during the slide show.
labels.root_cause: Insert Hyperlink formatted an empty range, and the slide show never read Hyperlink actions.

labels.symptom: Slide transitions change instantly instead of animating between the old and new slide.
labels.root_cause: The transition kept a cloned handle to the same texture the new slide was rendered into.

labels.symptom: Clicking the hex code field in a colour drop-down closes the menu, so a hex colour can't be typed.
labels.root_cause: egui Popup::menu defaults to PopupCloseBehavior::CloseOnClick, which closes on any click inside the popup, including one that focuses a text field.

labels.symptom: Linux users have no Flatpak repository to install and update the app from.
labels.root_cause: Releases ship only standalone Flatpak bundles with no hosted OSTree repository.

labels.symptom: Clicking the Home button in the title bar seems to do nothing; it silently creates a new blank document.
labels.root_cause: The Home icon ran file.new instead of showing the start screen.

labels.symptom: The Morph transition plays as a plain crossfade instead of moving shapes and text.
labels.root_cause: The morph helpers existed but nothing rendered frames with them.

labels.symptom: No RISC-V Linux packages (deb, rpm, tar.gz) are published for releases.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow has no riscv64 cross-compile and packaging job.

labels.symptom: CI runs show Node 20 deprecation warnings.
labels.root_cause: The GitHub Actions in the workflows were old versions that run on Node 20.

labels.symptom: There is no way to copy animations from one shape to another.
Inserting an equation only gives a one-line text field instead of a real formatted equation editor.
The app isn't listed in the Omarchy app catalog.
labels.root_cause: There was no OmaStore manifest.

labels.symptom: The README has no instructions for installing on Gentoo.
The automation export tool's schema doesn't list some formats and options the app does support, such as PDF.
labels.root_cause: The export tool's tools/list metadata was out of date with what file.export supports.

labels.symptom: There is no way to print from the app; users must export and print from another program.
Shape morph transitions redo their outline alignment on every frame.
labels.root_cause: The morph geometry and its alignment were rebuilt per frame instead of cached for the transition.

labels.symptom: On macOS, Finder does not offer the app for its documents, and open -a starts the app without opening the file.
labels.root_cause: Info.plist has no CFBundleDocumentTypes entry, and winit 0.30 does not handle the kAEOpenDocuments Apple event.

labels.symptom: Warnings and crash reports go nowhere, so users have no log to attach to a bug report.
labels.root_cause: The desktop app never installed a logger.

labels.symptom: Closing a document from the File menu or with Cmd/Ctrl+W discards unsaved changes without asking.
labels.root_cause: The menu item and shortcut run the close command directly instead of going through a save/discard/cancel prompt.

labels.symptom: The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window without a branded background or icon layout.
labels.root_cause: The DMG packaging had no background image or Finder layout settings.

labels.symptom: Text sometimes lays out in the wrong installed font (for example bold italic instead of regular), depending on timing.
labels.root_cause: Races in the font database lazy loading let a lookup see a partly loaded family or skip a family that another thread had just loaded.

labels.symptom: The command palette shows duplicate entries, and the default one fails with a missing path error instead of opening the dialog.
labels.root_cause: The palette lists engine commands that need parameters next to UI dialog commands with the same label.

labels.symptom: The animation 'rewind when done playing' setting is lost after saving and reopening a PPTX.
labels.root_cause: The writer always wrote fill="hold" and the reader never mapped fill="remove" to rewind.

labels.symptom: Audio and video playback options (autoplay, loop, rewind, volume) reset after saving and reopening a PPTX.
labels.root_cause: The PPTX writer did not export media playback options and the reader always used defaults.

labels.symptom: In the browser build, new items like comments are saved with an empty creation date.
labels.root_cause: std::time::SystemTime is unavailable on wasm so the timestamp helper returned an empty string instead of using js_sys::Date::now().

labels.symptom: After saving and reopening, comment replies become separate comments and resolved threads reopen.
labels.root_cause: Comment writer flattened replies and never wrote resolved status.

labels.symptom: In the browser, exporting images of all pages downloads only the current one.
labels.root_cause: Web export path ignored the 'all' flag and rendered only the selected slide.

labels.symptom: Pasting an image copied from a browser or screenshot with Ctrl+V does nothing.
labels.root_cause: egui-winit reads the clipboard as text on Ctrl+V and swallows the key press when there is no text, so no Paste event arrives.

labels.symptom: The progress and parity docs are out of date.
No Windows arm64 or aarch64 Flatpak builds are published and AppImages cannot update themselves.
labels.root_cause: Release matrix lacked arm64 targets; the from-source Flatpak lacked craft-fonts; no zsync info embedded.

labels.symptom: On Linux the window shows two title bars, and the window manager's bar does not match the app's theme.
labels.root_cause: The window manager draws server-side decorations on top of the app's own title bar.

labels.symptom: On Linux the interface does not follow the desktop's light/dark setting.
labels.root_cause: winit reports no system theme on Linux, so the desktop color scheme has to be read from the XDG Desktop Portal Settings interface.

labels.symptom: On Linux X11 the app looks zoomed in compared with the rest of the desktop.
labels.root_cause: winit scales by the panel's physical DPI reported by XRandR, while the desktop renders at 96 DPI.

labels.symptom: An automation export with an unsupported format reports success and writes a native-format file under the requested name.
labels.root_cause: Unknown explicit export formats fell through to the native format.

labels.symptom: An automation command to go to a nonexistent page or slide reports success and lands on the last one.
labels.root_cause: Out-of-range indexes were clamped and oversized ids read as 0.

labels.symptom: An automation command given an invalid object id silently edits the current selection instead of failing.
labels.root_cause: The id parameter parser treated invalid ids as absent, triggering the selection fallback.

labels.symptom: The README platforms badge URL has unescaped middle dots, so link checkers fail.
labels.root_cause: Non-ASCII characters in the badge URL are not percent-encoded.
